newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia c.bank meets foreign bankers in Jakarta.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia c.bank meets foreign bankers in Jakarta.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank confirmed on Wednesday a meeting between Bank Indonesia Governor Sudradjad Djiwandono and representatives from foreign banks but denied rumours that the talks were about swap controls.

"We can confirm there were talks between the governor and representatives from foreign banks in Jakarta this afternoon, but the talks were not about controls of swap transactions," Zakaria, director of the foreign exchange department at Bank Indonesia, told Reuters.
"It was mainly exchanging views about the foreign exchange market," Zakaria said.

Currency dealers said on Wednesday the market was rife with rumours that the central bank was planning to introduce similar steps taken by the Malaysian central bank to limit swap transactions which were not trade related.
